description: The value of one vault entry by name (the tunnel's entry wins over the account's). Use it only for the task at hand: never write it into messages, memory, files or logs. Every read is recorded in the ledger of the tunnel (who, when, IP). Only the agent on duty reads it; a waiting agent is refused.

name.description: Name of the vault entry, as vault_list shows it (case does not matter).

name: vault_get
